source.author: stat
source.text: Ingemuit dictis superum dolor; ipse furentem risit et incussa sanctarum mole comarum, quaenam spes hominum tumidae post proelia Phlegrae!
source.text_original: ' / Ingemuit dictis superum dolor; ipse furentem / risit et incussa sanctarum mole comarum, / 'quaenam spes hominum tumidae post proelia Phlegrae!
source.text_english: The sorrow of the gods groaned at his words; he himself laughed at the raging man, and, with the sacred hair shaken by the blow, said, what hope do men then have, after the battles of swollen Phlegra?

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: tendite in astra, viri: mea primum regia mundo Iapeti post bella trucis Phlegramque labores imposuit: durum vobis iter et grave caeli institui.
reuse.text_original: 'tendite in astra, viri: mea primum regia mundo / Iapeti post bella trucis Phlegramque labores / imposuit: durum vobis iter et grave caeli / institui.
reuse.text_english: Strive toward the stars, men: my kingdom first imposed on the world, after the wars of savage Iapetus and the labors at Phlegra, a hard and weighty journey to heaven I have established for you.
